text.zh-CN:
带状疱疹常表现为身体一侧的疼痛和成簇水疱，由曾感染的水痘病毒再次活跃引起。

- 疼痛或刺痒可能先于皮疹出现。
- 水疱随后干燥结痂，皮疹消退后疼痛可能继续。
- 面部、眼周或耳部受累需要特别重视。
text.en:
Shingles usually causes one-sided pain and clusters of blisters when dormant chickenpox virus reactivates.

- Pain or tingling can precede the rash.
- Pain can continue after blisters crust and heal.
- Facial, eye or ear involvement needs special attention.

text.zh-CN:
它不是从别人那里直接传来的带状疱疹。

- 既往水痘后病毒留在体内，之后可能重新活跃。
- 免疫功能减弱或某些治疗会增加发生机会。
- 没有水痘免疫的人接触带状疱疹病人可能感染水痘，而不是立即得带状疱疹。
text.en:
Shingles is not directly caught as shingles from someone else.

- Virus remains after chickenpox and may reactivate later.
- Reduced immunity or some treatments increase susceptibility.
- A person without chickenpox immunity can catch chickenpox from exposure to shingles.

text.zh-CN:
眼部或神经相关变化需要立即评估。

- 眼周或鼻部出疹、眼痛或视力改变，应尽快就医。
- 耳部症状伴听力变化或一侧面部无力，需要及时评估。
- 免疫低下者病情快速加重或全身很不舒服，应立即求助。
text.en:
Eye or neurological changes need urgent assessment.

- Rash near the eye or nose, eye pain or visual change requires prompt care.
- Ear symptoms with hearing change or facial weakness need review.
- Rapid deterioration with reduced immunity needs immediate help.

text.zh-CN:
尽早就医有助把握治疗时间。

- 疑似皮疹出现后尽快咨询，抗病毒治疗通常越早越有价值。
- 孕妇、儿童或免疫明显低下者，应直接寻求专业评估。
- 即使超过早期时段，眼部受累或明显恶化仍需就医，不能自行判断已经来不及。
text.en:
Early contact helps timely treatment.

- Seek advice soon after a suspected rash develops.
- Pregnancy, childhood or major immune suppression warrants professional assessment.
- Later presentation still needs care for eye involvement or deterioration.

text.zh-CN:
诊断主要结合皮疹分布和症状。

- 单侧成簇水疱及此前局部疼痛提供重要线索。
- 医生检查眼、耳或其他受累范围，以判断风险。
- 没有皮疹或表现不典型时，需进一步判断，不能仅凭身体一侧疼痛确诊。
text.en:
Diagnosis combines rash pattern and symptoms.

- One-sided grouped blisters with preceding local pain are useful clues.
- The clinician assesses eyes, ears and extent of disease.
- Atypical pain without rash requires further assessment rather than self-diagnosis.

text.zh-CN:
不同皮肤或疼痛问题可能相似。

- 接触性皮炎、其他疱疹和皮肤感染可出现皮疹或水疱。
- 未出疹时的胸背痛还可能来自其他器官或肌肉。
- 照片有助记录，但不能代替对眼部或全身危险表现的检查。
text.en:
Other skin and pain conditions can resemble shingles.

- Contact dermatitis, other herpes infections and skin infections can blister.
- Pain before a rash may also have non-skin causes.
- Photos aid documentation but do not replace examination of warning symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
治疗同时处理病毒活动和疼痛。

- 适合时尽早使用口服抗病毒药，具体取决于严重程度和风险。
- 止痛处理帮助睡眠和日常活动。
- 眼耳受累或免疫低下者可能需要专科方案。
text.en:
Treatment addresses viral activity and pain.

- Early oral antivirals are considered according to severity and risk.
- Pain control supports sleep and function.
- Eye, ear or immune-compromised cases may need specialist care.

text.zh-CN:
抗病毒药和止痛药不能混为一谈。

- 阿昔洛韦等针对病毒，唇疱疹药膏不能直接当作全身带状疱疹方案。
- 口服药可能恶心、头晕，少数有肾脏问题；既有肾病或尿量减少要告知医生。
- 神经痛药用于持续痛时可能嗜睡，用药后不适应及时反馈。
text.en:
Antivirals and pain medicines have different roles.

- Aciclovir targets virus; cold-sore cream is not a substitute for an appropriate shingles plan.
- Oral treatment can cause nausea or dizziness and rarely kidney problems; report kidney disease or reduced urine.
- Medicines for persistent nerve pain may cause drowsiness; report troublesome effects promptly.

text.zh-CN:
没有能代替抗病毒治疗的特殊食谱。

- 维持可接受的均衡饮食，不因民间禁忌大量删去食物。
- 按个人健康情况保持适当饮水，服药时有肾病或限液要求需核对计划。
text.en:
No special diet replaces indicated antiviral treatment.

- Maintain balanced tolerable meals without broad unsupported exclusions.
- Keep suitable hydration and check the plan if kidney disease or fluid restriction applies.

text.zh-CN:
保护皮疹并减少对他人的暴露。

- 保持皮肤清洁干燥，穿宽松衣物，必要时用不粘敷料覆盖。
- 冷敷可减轻不适，避免敷料粘住水疱。
- 皮疹渗液且不能遮盖时，避免工作上学等密切接触场景。
text.en:
Protect the rash and reduce exposure to others.

- Keep it clean and dry, using loose clothing or non-stick covering.
- A cool compress may ease discomfort.
- Avoid close-contact settings when a weeping rash cannot be covered.

text.zh-CN:
部分接触对象和患者需特别安排。

- 避免接触未有水痘免疫的孕妇、免疫低下者和新生儿。
- 乳房出疹且哺乳时，先询问怎样避免婴儿接触皮损。
- 孕期疑似带状疱疹应由专业人员判断是否需要治疗。
text.en:
Some patients and contacts need additional planning.

- Avoid exposure of susceptible pregnant people, immunocompromised people and newborns.
- Breast lesions during breastfeeding require advice to prevent infant contact.
- Pregnancy warrants a professional treatment assessment.

text.zh-CN:
皮肤与神经疼痛恢复速度不同。

- 皮疹可能需数周愈合。
- 皮疹消失后仍痛，应讨论神经痛管理而非只继续涂皮肤药。
- 出现红肿渗脓、视力变化或新的无力时，应提前复诊。
text.en:
Skin and nerve pain may recover at different speeds.

- The rash can take several weeks to heal.
- Persistent pain after healing needs nerve-pain review.
- Redness, swelling or pus suggesting infection, vision changes or new weakness needs earlier assessment.

text.zh-CN:
需要了解的并发症以疼痛和器官受累为主。

- 带状疱疹后神经痛指皮疹消退后持续较久的疼痛。
- 皮损可继发细菌感染或留下色素变化。
- 眼部受累可损害视力，面神经受累可影响表情和听力。
text.en:
Complications include persistent pain and organ involvement.

- Post-herpetic neuralgia is pain persisting after the rash.
- Skin can develop bacterial infection or pigment changes.
- Eye or facial-nerve involvement can affect sight, facial movement or hearing.

text.zh-CN:
疫苗和接触管理各有作用。

- 按年龄、免疫情况及当地安排咨询带状疱疹疫苗。
- 得过一次仍可能复发，是否接种仍值得讨论。
- 出疹期间遮盖渗液部位并避免高风险接触，可减少水痘传播机会。
text.en:
Vaccination and exposure precautions serve different purposes.

- Discuss vaccination according to age, immunity and local recommendations.
- Previous shingles does not rule out recurrence or a vaccine discussion.
- Covering lesions and avoiding vulnerable contacts reduces chickenpox transmission risk.
